UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a registered user's profile, storing personal details and preferences for features like the AI Itinerary Planner.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

phoneNumber.description: The user's primary phone number for contact and booking management.

preferences.description: A list of strings representing user travel preferences (e.g., 'adventure', 'relaxation', 'budget-friendly').

budgetRange.description: User's preferred budget range for travel, e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

lastLogin.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

Bus.title: Bus
Bus.description: Represents a physical bus vehicle operated by a travel company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Bus entity.

busNumber.description: The registration number or identifier of the bus (e.g., vehicle plate number).

operatorName.description: The name of the bus operating company.

busType.description: The type of bus (e.g., 'AC Sleeper', 'Non-AC Seater', 'Volvo Multi-Axle').

totalSeats.description: The total number of seats available on the bus.

amenities.description: List of amenities available on the bus (e.g., 'WiFi', 'Charging Point', 'Water Bottle').

Route.title: Route
Route.description: Defines a bus route between an origin and a destination city.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Route entity.

originCity.description: The starting city of the route.

destinationCity.description: The final destination city of the route.

distanceKm.description: The approximate distance of the route in kilometers.

durationHours.description: The approximate duration of the journey in hours.

intermediateStopIds.description: References to Stop entities that are intermediate stops along this route. (Relationship: Stop N:N Route)

Stop.title: Stop
Stop.description: Represents a geographical location where a bus can stop, either as an intermediate point or a major boarding/dropping point.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Stop entity.

name.description: The common name of the stop (e.g., 'MG Road', 'Bus Stand').

city.description: The city where the stop is located.

address.description: The full address of the stop.

latitude.description: The geographical latitude of the stop.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude of the stop.

BusSchedule.title: BusSchedule
BusSchedule.description: Represents a specific instance of a bus journey on a particular date and time for a given route.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BusSchedule entity.

busId.description: Reference to the Bus entity operating this schedule. (Relationship: Bus 1:N BusSchedule)

routeId.description: Reference to the Route entity for this schedule. (Relationship: Route 1:N BusSchedule)

departureDateTime.description: The scheduled departure date and time of the bus for this journey (in Indian timezone context).

arrivalDateTime.description: The scheduled arrival date and time of the bus for this journey (in Indian timezone context).

basePrice.description: The base price per seat for this schedule.

availableSeatsCount.description: The number of currently available seats for this schedule.

status.description: The current status of the bus schedule (e.g., 'scheduled', 'departed', 'completed', 'cancelled').

boardingPoints.description: A list of boarding points and their scheduled times for this journey.

droppingPoints.description: A list of dropping points and their scheduled times for this journey.

Seat.title: Seat
Seat.description: Represents a specific seat's state and details for a particular bus schedule.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Seat entity (e.g., combining BusSchedule ID and seat number).

busScheduleId.description: Reference to the BusSchedule entity this seat belongs to. (Relationship: BusSchedule 1:N Seat)

seatNumber.description: The unique number or identifier of the seat on the bus (e.g., 'A1', '12').

deck.description: The deck where the seat is located (e.g., 'Lower', 'Upper' for multi-deck buses).

status.description: The current status of the seat ('available', 'booked', 'held', 'reserved_female', 'reserved_male').

rate.description: The fare for this specific seat.

genderPreference.description: Indicates if the seat has a specific gender preference or restriction ('male', 'female', 'any').

bookingId.description: Reference to the Booking entity if this seat is booked. (Relationship: Booking 1:N Seat)

passengerId.description: Reference to the Passenger entity occupying this seat. Used for showing neighboring passenger gender. (Relationship: Passenger 1:1 Seat)

Passenger.title: Passenger
Passenger.description: Represents details of an individual passenger traveling on a booking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Passenger entity.

phoneNumber.description: The passenger's phone number (optional, often linked to a primary passenger).

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a user's bus ticket reservation, including chosen seats, passenger details, and payment information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Booking entity.

bookingReference.description: A unique, user-friendly reference code for the booking.

busScheduleId.description: Reference to the BusSchedule entity for this booking. (Relationship: BusSchedule 1:N Booking)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity if the booking was made by a registered user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Booking)

primaryPassengerId.description: Reference to the main Passenger entity responsible for this booking. (Relationship: Passenger 1:N Booking)

contactPhoneNumber.description: The phone number used for booking lookup and contact.

contactEmail.description: The email address used for booking confirmation and contact.

seatIds.description: References to Seat entities included in this booking. (Relationship: Seat N:N Booking)

passengerIds.description: References to Passenger entities associated with this booking. (Relationship: Passenger N:N Booking)

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount paid for this booking.

paymentStatus.description: The status of the payment for this booking ('pending', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded').

bookingStatus.description: The overall status of the booking ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'modified').

bookingDateTime.description: The date and time when the booking was made.

boardingPointName.description: The name of the chosen boarding point for this booking (e.g., 'Majestic Bus Stand').

droppingPointName.description: The name of the chosen dropping point for this booking (e.g., 'Shivaji Nagar').

Itinerary.title: Itinerary
Itinerary.description: Represents a personalized travel itinerary generated by the AI planner based on user preferences and history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Itinerary entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity for whom this itinerary was generated. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Itinerary)

title.description: A descriptive title for the itinerary (e.g., 'Goa Beach Holiday').

description.description: A detailed description of the itinerary.

generatedByAI.description: Indicates if the itinerary was generated by an AI (true) or manually created (false).

preferencesUsed.description: A snapshot of user preferences used for generating this itinerary.

budget.description: The budget category considered for this itinerary (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high').

durationDays.description: The planned duration of the itinerary in days.

activities.description: A list of suggested activities or points of interest for the itinerary.

suggestedBookingIds.description: References to BusSchedule IDs or other relevant booking IDs suggested in this itinerary. (Relationship: BusSchedule N:N Itinerary)

generationDateTime.description: The date and time when this itinerary was generated.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: A notification sent to a user regarding their bookings, account, or promotions.

userId.description: The user ID receiving the notification.

read.description: Whether the user has seen the alert.

params.name: passengerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the passenger within the booking.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling, ensuring a secure, scalable, and debuggable database. User-specific data, such as `UserProfile` and `Itinerary`, is strictly segregated under `/users/{userId}/...` paths. This path-based ownership makes authorization rules extremely simple and efficient, as a `request.auth.uid` check directly against the `{userId}` wildcard ensures a user can only access their own data. The `Booking` collection is made top-level (`/bookings/{bookingId}`) to facilitate easy lookup by `contactPhoneNumber` for booking management (a core requirement), while still retaining a `userId` field for authenticated user ownership. This allows for clear authorization rules: authenticated users can access their bookings via `resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid`, and unauthenticated users can perform restricted lookups using `contactPhoneNumber` and `bookingReference`.

Crucially, **Authorization Independence** is achieved for `Seat` data through significant denormalization. Each `Seat` document (`/busSchedules/{busScheduleId}/seats/{seatId}`) will include all necessary information for display, such as `status`, `rate`, `genderPreference`, and a denormalized `bookedPassengerGender` field (if the seat is booked). This means that security rules evaluating access to a `Seat` document do not need to perform `get()` operations on parent `BusSchedule` or related `Passenger` or `Booking` documents to determine read access or rendering information. This design prevents cascading rule dependencies and enables atomic operations for seat selection (handled securely via Cloud Functions).

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters)** are supported across the design:
*   **Public Reference Data:** Collections like `/buses`, `/routes`, `/stops`, and `/busSchedules` are designed to be publicly readable by all authenticated users. This homogeneous security posture allows for efficient `list` operations without requiring Firestore rules to act as data filters (e.g., users can list all available bus schedules for a given route without needing per-document authorization checks).
*   **User-Owned Data:** For `/users/{userId}/userProfile` and `/users/{userId}/itineraries`, `list` operations are naturally restricted by the path, allowing users to query *only* their own data efficiently.
*   **Seat Selection:** Users can `list` all seats for a specific `busScheduleId` (`/busSchedules/{busScheduleId}/seats`). Since `Seat` documents contain all necessary display information (including denormalized gender for neighboring passengers), no further server-side filtering or `get()` calls are required within security rules for displaying the interactive seat map.
*   **Booking Management:** Authenticated users can `list` their own bookings by querying `/bookings` where `userId == request.auth.uid`. Unauthenticated users can `list` a specific booking by querying `/bookings` with `contactPhoneNumber` and `bookingReference`, with rules enforcing that only the specific booking matching these criteria is returned, thus preventing broad, unfiltered reads.
